name: Apprenticeship — Legacy Completed (Near Year-End, AY 25/26), Different Course POST Next AY (26/27)
description: Provider A's apprenticeship (standard 21) is a 'legacy' record: created directly by Commitments' ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent, never a draft — planned start 2025-08-01, planned end 2026-07-31 (AY 25/26). Provider A then completes it via PUT, with completion (2026-07-30) and achievement (2026-07-31) both landing right at the tail end of AY 25/26 — one day before, and on, the last day of the academic year (2026-07-31) — via the legacy PUT route (/providers/{ukprn}/learning/{learnerKey}) addressed by LearnerKey (FLP-2052). Provider A then POSTs a new draft for the SAME learner but a DIFFERENT course (standard 30), starting in AY 26/27 (2026-08-01), via the new-style route (/providers/{ukprn}/apprenticeships?academicYear=2627). Same provider throughout — no second provider involved, unlike apprenticeship-legacy-completed-both-post-course2. Exercises CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle's GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode) lookup: the completed standard-21 row isn't a candidate for the standard-30 course code, so a second, independent, unapproved ApprenticeshipLearning row should be created rather than the POST being treated as an update. Commitments then approves the standard-30 draft via ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent (AddLearningCommandHandler's approval branch). Provider A then DELETEs the learner scoped to AY 26/27 (academicYear=2627) — exercises the AY boundary in ApprenticeshipLearningDomainModel.OverlapsAcademicYear (StartDate <= dates.End && CompletionDate >= dates.Start) right at the edge: standard-21's CompletionDate (2026-07-30) sits one day before AY 26/27's start (2026-08-01), so it should NOT overlap AY 26/27 and must be excluded from the DELETE, leaving only standard-30 removed.

steps.name: Commitments Approves an Apprenticeship (Provider A, Standard 21, Never a Draft, AY 25/26)
SLD (Provider A) Records Completion, Standard 21 (Completes 2026-07-30, One Day Before AY 25/26 Ends)
SLD (Provider A) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship, Different Course (Standard 30), AY 26/27
Two separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner (completed standard 21 AY 25/26, new standard 30 draft AY 26/27)
New standard-30 row is an unapproved draft, not removed, starting within AY 26/27
SLD (Provider A) Deletes the Learner, Scoped to AY 26/27

assertions.name: Standard-30 (AY 26/27) row is removed; standard-21 (AY 25/26) row untouched
